tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rata gling 'dus pa skor bzhi'i bka' srung rnams kyi gsol ka nyung ngu phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa bzhugs so//

oṃ a kā ro sogs kyi byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐: sgrub pa lung gi pho nya chen po ni: nyi ma'i dkyil nas bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: sprul pa yang sprul pho nya dpung dang bcas: bdud 'dul dbang drag dpal gyi bka' nyan ma: khro bo'i sprul pa tshangs pa'i lings pa mo: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: dam sri nyul le'i bar chad rdul du rlogs: gnam lha'i lcam mo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: khrag mdog dmar mo bswe yi lan phran can: shin tu mi bzad gtum chen khrag 'thung ma: dpal gyi pho nya dpal gyi thugs las sprul: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: dam sri nyul le'i bar chad rdul du rlogs: hūm̐: pad+ma gsung gi bka' srung thugs dam can: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: dus min 'chi dang ltas ngan rbod zor zlog: dam sri nyul le'i bar chad rdul du rlogs: oṃ kro dhī shwa rī pañca a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi: tri pa tri pa hūm̐ phaṭa: kha la ro sha kha la ro sha hūm̐ phaṭa: yak+ṣa kun baṃ dzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa: dz+wa la raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: dz+wa la a mu kaṃ dz+wa la a mu kaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: a mṛta ba liṃ ta rak+ta khā hi: zhes gter gzhung dang*/ sngags srung ma'i gtor bsngos ni/ bh+yo/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// ma dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// sngags kyi srung ma e ka dzā ṭi ma// 'khor du ye shes ma mo 'bum gyis bskor// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen srung*// zas su dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag za// ma 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i dus la bab// dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa'i dus la bab// bla ma'i sku tshe bsring ba'i dus la bab// rnal 'byor bar chad bsal ba'i dus la bab// chos skyong phrin las bsgrub pa'i dus la bab// de bas ma mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

ces drung rma ses mdzad pa'o// de nas dam can mgar ba dmar nag gi gtor bsngos ni/ kyai: 'dzam gling nyi ma nub phyogs na: pho brang rtag chags rten mkhar nas: 'dzam bu gling gi skyes gcig pu: rdo rje legs pa gshegs su gsol: dge bsnyen chen po drag rtsal can: 'dzin ging brtan ma'i tshogs dang bcas: btsan rgod drag po stong gis bskor: dpon g.yog 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya tri shū la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ar+ghaṃ sogs/ shab+da āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: dam can skyes bu thig le rtsal: khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba ni: mkhar thabs bshos bu ra yis mtshan: sha khrag dmar gtor rak+ta dang: māṃ sa ra yi gsur chen dang: smyug rgod khrab byang rnga khrab dang: mdzes pa'i glu gar rol mo dbyangs: spyan gzigs dkor chas thugs dam bskang: oṃ badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya: srog tri'u ma ra ṇa: rat+na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: i daṃ ba liṃ khā hi khā hi: oṃ badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya srog tri'u dzaḥdza: badz+ra li la ma hūm̐ dza: i daṃ ba liṃ khā hi khā hi: oṃ badz+ra ma hā ma tri dung dung tri dza: i daṃ ba liṃ khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: dam can skyes bu badz+ra thig le rtsal: lha mi'i 'jig rten khams na dbang phyug btsan: dbang rtags rdo rje dgra bo'i tsit+ta 'dzin: dge bsnyen chen po khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: seng ge dang ni ra skyes 'chib nas kyang: dar dmar gsol zhing rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston: btsan dang brtan ma'i 'khor g.yog bsam mi khyab: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: yang cig bzhengs shig nag po ti pa rā tsa khyod: lho brag mkhar chu'i phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pa: dge bsnyen smyo kha zhes su mtshan yang gsol: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag cag rig 'dzin rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi: mi mthun rkyen sol mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrubs: gter gzhung dngos lags/ lung btsan dang g.yu sgron ma gter gzhung nas btus pa/

kyai: ya ki sgo mo brag dmar nas: jo bo btsan gyi rgyal po ni: skyes bu lung btsan spyan 'dren no: 'dur 'dur 'dur gyis gnas 'dir byon: phud dang bshos dang mchod pa bzhes: bkra shis dar rgyas che ba yi: grogs dang mgon skyob chen po mdzod: kyai: ma ki sman yul sman ra nas: g.yu mtsho sngon mo'i pho brang nas: sring gcig rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: mthun pa'i phud gtor 'bul gyis bzhes: hūm̐: thugs rje chen po'i bka' srung ba: bran g.yog gnod sbyin nor bsnyag ni: mdog nag a tsa ra yi gzugs: 'dir byon brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: sdang ba'i dgra la cho 'phrul thongs: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: sngags bsngos bya ba ni 'di ltar lags/ oṃ e ka dzā ṭi bh+yo dza: a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: oṃ nā ga rak+sha kro dha pa tsa la ti: dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la khā hi: a mṛta ba liṃ ta rak+ta khā hi: oṃ byi nu tsa na sa ma ya: rak+ta ku ru: tsa ra na: hū na hū na ru tsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: ma ma 'ur 'ur: sman sil sil: ru ru ting laṃ: ting ma ma dzaḥdza: ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi: oṃ bha to ra li ya: sa de aṃ gu sha dza: a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: 'di yan la dmar gtor gcig bsngos la phul lo// 'di man la dkar gtor bsngos la phul/ hūm̐: gling bzhi'i byang phyogs gser ri bdun gyi rtser: rin chen sna tshogs brtsegs pa'i lding khang nas: rnam thos bu yi bang mdzod gnyer kha ba: gnod sbyin dbang po gzhan gyis mi thub pa: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: mnga' thang stobs dang 'byor pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: stong gsum 'dzam gling dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul can: nor lha kun gyi pho nya myur mgyogs can: nor gyi bdag po dge bsnyen ye shes grags: 'dir gshegs dkar gsum brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: snang gsal pra dang longs spyod dngos grub stsol:

bh+yo: bsil ba tshal dang nye ba'i tshan+dho ha: bden bral mun pa can gyi dur khrod nas: dkor gyi bdag mo rdo rje ngas nus ma: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: dkor rnams srung zhing spel ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dge bsnyen chen po she'u mkha' ri'i sku: mes po gnam la thog 'brug chem chem lags: phyi mo gser gyi nya mtsho phyug mo lags: yab la mtshan gsol gangs kyi ga 'u rje: yum ni sman chen spu ra spyang mo lags: de gnyis bshos pas sprul pa'i mi bo che: lho stod she'u mi yul pha ki na: she'u rgyal po shel bdag btsun mo'i bu: she phrug gzugs mdzes 'gro ba skye zhes bya: tshe dbang mkha' ri ma sang ging sprul dang: lcam mo shel bza' sman gyi mthu mo che: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin: dam las ma 'da' gang 'dod dngos grub stsol: bcol pa'i phrin las ma thogs myur du mdzod: oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta dzaḥdza: ba liṃ ta khā hi: tri'u tri'u ba liṃ ta khā hi: oṃ ra li pra ma ya dza: ba liṃ ta khā hi: oṃ badz+ra trig na trig dza: trig sman ruṃ ruṃ tsam tsam dza: ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul lo// sngags 'chang a rā gas sbyar ba'o/// /
